text:
Type: black picture ledge
Use: displaying framed photos, art prints and books; living room, bedroom, home office, hallway
Style: minimalist, modern, contemporary
Materials: matte painted board, small copper-colored screw covers
Colors: matte black, charcoal
Shape: long slim narrow shelf with a raised front lip that holds frames upright, low back panel, clean straight lines, discreet and low profile
Feel: graphic, gallery-like, tidy, crisp
Goes with: white walls, black frames, monochrome art, light or dark wood; modern, minimalist or Scandinavian rooms

product.name: MOSSLANDA
product.description: The picture ledge has a special groove to keep smaller frames at the perfect angle.
